counties.title: Counties
counties.description: Recorders to pull: nyc (all five boroughs, ACRIS), philadelphia, cook (Chicago and suburbs).

daysOfRecords.title: Days of records
daysOfRecords.description: Deeds recorded in the last N days of each county's published data (counties publish with a lag, so this counts back from the newest record each one has).

minPrice.title: Min price (USD)
minPrice.description: Skip transfers below this price. The default 1,000 drops $0-$10 nominal transfers between relatives, trusts and related companies.

includeNonSaleDeeds.title: Include other deed types
includeNonSaleDeeds.description: Also include quit claim, executor, condemnation, land bank and similar deeds. Off = market sales deeds (warranty, trustee, sheriff's deeds).

buyerKeywords.title: Buyer name contains
buyerKeywords.description: Keep transfers where a buyer name contains any of these, e.g. LLC, TRUST, PROPERTIES, HOLDINGS (investor buyers).

excludeBuyerKeywords.title: Buyer name excludes
excludeBuyerKeywords.description: Drop transfers where a buyer name contains any of these, e.g. BANK, MORTGAGE, CITY OF.

zipCodes.title: ZIP codes or prefixes
zipCodes.description: Property ZIP, e.g. 60614 or 191. NYC deeds carry no property ZIP and are dropped when this is set.

maxRows.title: Max deeds
maxRows.description: Cap on rows returned, split evenly across counties. Controls cost.
